tools.name: python
tools.label: Python
tools.note: Only the Microsoft Store shortcut is present; Python itself is not installed.
tools.install: Install Python for all users: winget install --id Python.Python.3.12 -e --scope machine, or run the python.org full installer, choose Customize installation and pick the all-users option.

tools.name: code
tools.label: VS Code
tools.note: A copy installed only in another account (for example VS Code's User setup under %LOCALAPPDATA%) is not available here.
tools.install: Install VS Code with the System setup (not the User setup) from code.visualstudio.com, or: winget install --id Microsoft.VisualStudioCode -e --scope machine.
